text_block_list.text:
—The day of the Mainichi Okan is finally 
here!

"With their eyes on the world, 'The 
Phantom Bird' El Condor Pasa, 'The Monster 
II' Grass Wonder, and 'The Otherworldly 
Fugitive' Silence Suzuka!"

This race brings together Umamusume across 
generations...! The crowd's anticipation 
has reached its absolute peak!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...The stands are quite fired up this 
time as well, aren't they?"
choice_data_list: Looks like you're not nervous, huh?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes... Today, I will simply take the 
lead as always.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: That is all...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
May I intrude for just a moment? 
Suzuka-san.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Actually... El and Grass gave me a message 
to pass along to you...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: A message...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Um... El is... *Ahem*.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"‘Today, I shall surpass you and walk the 
path of the "World's Strongest", yeeees!’"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Wash your neck and wait for me, deeeesu! 
I'm burning up~!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...is what she said!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (It looks surprisingly similar...!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So, Grass-chan's message was...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "I look forward to working with you."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...is what they were saying!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Is that all?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! But El-chan aside, I'm sure 
Grass-chan is burning with passion inside 
too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"She wanted to meet at the racetrack, so 
she just left a message!"
choice_data_list: Are you getting nervous after all?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, not at all. If anything, it's made 
me look forward to the race even more.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The view you see after overtaking a 
formidable rival is so incredibly 
beautiful...!

At her words, Special Week jumped in 
surprise.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san...! May I pass that message 
along to those two...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to pass on Suzuka-san's blazing 
passion...! I'm sure they'll both be 
thrilled!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind, but... You seem awfully 
pumped up, Spe-chan."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Maybe it's because it's full of 
friends, but somehow even I'm getting 
restless...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wait, I shouldn't bother you too much!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm cheering for you, Suzuka-san!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Well, see you later!
choice_data_list:
They're definitely playing to win, aren't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, that was indeed the case.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
“Still, no matter what dreams the two of 
them have, I won't give up the lead...!”

—And so, the curtains rose on a 
spark-flying Mainichi Okan...!
